# Stock Wide `Array(Nullable(T))` numeric fixture

Generated by `scripts/generate_array_nullable_numeric_fixture.sh` with the
pinned ClickHouse 26.7.1.1315 official build in a disposable local store. The
captured part contains `pk UInt64` plus one `Array(Nullable(T))` column for
each of `UInt8`, `UInt16`, `UInt32`, `UInt64`, `Int8`, `Int16`, `Int32`,
`Int64`, `Float32`, and `Float64`. The source rows are inserted as RowBinary;
floating-point payloads are supplied as IEEE-754 bit patterns. Generation
runs `CHECK TABLE`, and the bidirectional oracle attaches the captured part to
stock ClickHouse and checks it again.

The 11 keys are `1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13, 17, 19, 21, 25`. Every array is empty
for the first two rows and again for keys 13 and 17, producing two fully empty
marks at granularity two. Keys 9 and 11 contain three NULL elements total and
no values, so that all-NULL mark advances both the null-map and value streams
by three child elements. The remaining rows cover integer zero/min/max values,
NULL interleaving, float signed zero, a quiet-NaN payload, infinities, max
finite values, and signed subnormals. Physical NULL payload slots are expected
to be the default zero value for each leaf width.

Each nullable numeric array has exactly three physical streams:
`<column>.size0`, `<column>.null`, and `<column>`. The part uses Wide layout,
LZ4 data, uncompressed plain `.mrk2` marks, six data marks with row counts
`[2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1]`, and a final sentinel record. `SHA256SUMS` pins every
captured part file. This fixture certifies only the pinned producer build and
listed one-level numeric nullable-array shapes; it does not certify nested or
other Nullable compositions.
